item.title: Tailwing 1.1.0-beta.11
item.description:
Tailwing 1.1 Beta 11

Calls come first. If your notes are still being written when a call starts, Tailwing pauses them at once and carries on where it left off after the call. Join opens Zoom or Teams directly.

First names. Notes use first names, and only names said in the meeting or on the invite. Tailwing no longer guesses a surname from an email address.

Your own notes in place. Lines you type during a call go under the topic being discussed when you typed them, marked with a small pencil. Return starts a new point, and Tab and Shift-Tab nest it.

Clearer progress. While notes are being written, the page says how far along they are and how long is left.

One place to ask. Asking from the bar no longer opens a second Ask panel. Starter questions match your work, and a question about several meetings reads each of them in full.

Dictation from the start. Dictation is on after setup, and setup asks for the permission it needs to type.

In your language. Everything added since the last update is translated into all 24 languages.

Smaller fixes. Send To no longer covers a line's time, exports show Decisions once, and the sample meeting stays out of your exports.

item.title: Tailwing 1.1.0-beta.10
item.description:
Tailwing 1.1 Beta 10

One call, one set of notes. If Tailwing quits, closes unexpectedly or is reopened while your call is still going, it picks the same meeting up again: one transcript, and notes written once over the whole call. A call that was already split in two can be joined with Join with the Earlier Part.

Notes that read like a document. Finished notes use the reading size with calmer spacing. Decisions have their own section, next steps read as a checklist with each owner's first name, and a line's time shows when you point at it. A decision appears once, without a label in front of it.

Shorter, sharper notes. Bullets are about a fifth shorter. Decisions are listed once, in their own section. People are named instead of written as "Someone". Financial terms like SAFE and Carta are written correctly.

Ask about this meeting. A field at the end of a finished meeting's notes asks about that meeting first, then all of them.

A cleaner meeting header. Transcript, Ask, Folder, Copy and Share sit in the toolbar as real buttons, with Share the main one. A private meeting shows no Copy or Share there; Share and Save, which ask first, are in the options menu.

Calmer during calls. The meeting's page no longer shows the live transcript while a call runs, unless you turn it on in Settings, Meetings. Live translation still shows it. The side panel opens wider.

Steadier when your audio changes. Headphones that connect, disconnect or switch to your phone mid-call no longer freeze Tailwing. Your microphone stays where it is when only your speakers change, and the transcript notes it quietly if the microphone itself changes.

Notes always finish. If writing the notes ever stalls, the meeting says so and offers Try Again. AI tools reading a meeting while its notes are being written are told how far along they are.

Set up next. Set up next only suggests what you haven't connected yet.

item.title: Tailwing 1.1.0-beta.9
item.description:
Tailwing 1.1 Beta 9

Calls come first. While you're on a call, Tailwing pauses its downloads and background work, and picks them up again when the call ends. It also transcribes at a low priority, so your meeting app gets your Mac first.

A new meeting banner. The banner that offers notes for a call is smaller and clearer. If you also use Parafoil, a new setting, "Let Parafoil take notes when it's running," lets it take the call instead.

Shorter setup. Setup now covers only what your first meeting needs. After your first meeting, Home suggests what to set up next, starting with using your notes in Claude. Everything else is still in Settings.

Better Ask answers. Catch-ups are tighter, and questions about what was settled find the answer more often.

Invites work after setup. An invite link now counts for 30 days after you set up Tailwing, and you can paste one in Settings, Pro. When the friends you invite join, your Pro unlocks within the hour.

Fixes. After a call ends normally, no "Notes stopped" bar stays on screen. The "Tailwing is still running" note appears in the right place on the right display. The offer to take notes closes by itself when the call stops using your microphone. Tailwing keeps taking notes when Granola is also open. Setup no longer lets you skip saving your recovery code. The toolbar shows "Starting…" while notes begin, then Stop.

item.title: Tailwing 1.0.0-rc.8.2
item.description:
Tailwing 1.0.0 RC 8.2

Notes now stop by themselves when a browser call ends. After a Meet in Chrome, Tailwing could go on taking notes until you stopped it: Chrome kept hold of the microphone, and a normal room is rarely quiet enough for Tailwing to decide the call was over.

This version watches the same signal as the orange microphone dot in your menu bar, so leaving the call ends notes within seconds. If you were only stepping away, the call taking the microphone again within two minutes picks up the same meeting.

The AI tools connector is still paused, as in RC 8.1. It comes back in the next release.
